title: The Real Earnings of a Day Trader
summary: Day-trading course founder's blog post on trader earnings using his own atypical results, with a disclaimer that most day traders lose and student results are not tracked.

assertions.quote: Trading is risky, and most day traders lose money.
none of these places tell you about the success rate of becoming a successful trader

verdicts.note: Salary aggregators sample employed or surviving traders only.

The full distribution shows the median persistent trader loses US$23 a day and only 0.5% exceed a bank teller's wage, so any average describing earners overstates the typical entrant; published salary figures themselves are not examined.

assertions.quote: We do not track the typical results of our past or current customers.

verdicts.note: The FTC alleges Automators does not track the results of its coaching clients while advertising specific student earnings; one documented instance of a general claim.

assertions.quote: The results shared are based on my personal trading experiences and are not typical.
being a profitable trader doesn’t mean nailing every trade. It’s about knowing when to cut your losses.
the golden hours are between 8:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. That’s where 99% of my profits come from.

verdicts.note: Volume and volatility peak at the open, but this is one trader's self-reported result.
